blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to two decimal places using the graphical method, by finding some interval of sign change: \(f(x) = x^{3} - x - 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa sawal mein interval nahin diya gaya; yeh kaam pehle hamein khud karna hai, poore numbers try kar ke.
Diya kya hai? Sirf \(f(x) = x^3 - x - 1\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehle interval of sign change, phir graph se real root do decimals tak.
Rule kaunsa? LRT (interval ke liye) aur graphical method (root ke liye).
Plan: continuity, whole numbers par sign dekhna, 0.1 ke qadmon par table, graph, 0.01 par zoom, aur LRT se rounding ki tasdeeq.
Ek baat aur: whole numbers try karte waqt jaise hi sign badle, ruk jaiye; wahi interval aap ka hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^3 - x - 1\).
Maloom karna: is ka real root, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: graphical method. Interval diya nahin gaya, is liye method ka pehla step (interval of sign change dhoondna) bhi karna hai.

Continuity
\[f(c) = \lim_{x \to c}(x^3 - x - 1) \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}\]
Kyun: \(f\) polynomial hai, is liye har real \(x\) par continuous hai. Yani jo bhi interval milega, us par LRT lag sakta hai.

Interval of sign change dhoondein
\[f(0) = -1,\quad f(1) = -1\]
\[f(2) = 8 - 2 - 1 = 5\]
\[f(1)\,f(2) = (-1)(5) < 0\]
Kyun: poore numbers try kiye to sign pehli dafa 1 aur 2 ke beech badla, is liye \([1, 2]\) interval of sign change hai. Negative taraf bhi dekh lein: \(f(-1) = -1\), \(f(-2) = -7\), koi sign change nahin. Asal mein is cubic ka sirf ek hi real root hai, to humein bas yahi interval chahiye.

Graph banana
Kyun: points plot kar ke smooth curve banaiye (answer figure dekhiye). Curve \((1, -1)\) se \((2, 5)\) tak upar jati hai aur axis ko 1.3 aur 1.4 ke beech, 1.3 ke qareeb kaatti hai, kyun ke \(f(1.3) = -0.103\) zero ke bohat qareeb hai jab ke \(f(1.4) = 0.344\) door hai.
Graph banate waqt \(x\)-axis par 1 se 2 tak das barabar khaane lijiye aur \(y\)-axis par \(-1\) se 5 tak. Is tarah curve poore kaghaz par phaili hogi aur crossing saaf nazar aayegi.

0.01 ke qadmon par zoom
\[f(1.30) = -0.1030\]
\[f(1.31) = -0.0619\]
\[f(1.32) = -0.0200\]
\[f(1.33) = 0.0226\]
\[f(1.34) = 0.0661\]
Kyun: sign 1.32 aur 1.33 ke beech badla. \(f(1.32) = -0.0200\) aur \(f(1.33) = 0.0226\) taqreeban barabar hain, yani crossing beech ke qareeb hai. Aisi surat mein sirf graph dekh kar faisla mushkil hai, is liye agla step zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq: do decimal places pakke karein
\[f(1.315) = -0.0411 < 0\]
\[f(1.325) = 0.0012 > 0\]
Kyun: \(f(1.325)\) pehle hi positive hai, is liye root \(]1.315, 1.325[\) mein hai, aur yahan ka har number round ho kar 1.32 banta hai. To \(x \approx 1.32\), jo answer key ke mutabiq hai.
Dhyan dein: jab do values barabar si hon to 1.33 likhne ki ghalti aam hai; \(c \pm 0.005\) wala test hi sahi faisla karta hai.
Yaad rakhiye: graph se parha hua jawab tabhi pakka hai jab yeh sign test bhi us ki tasdeeq kare. Agar sign test ulta nikle to apna graph dobara dekhiye.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = x^3 - x - 1 plotted through the points at steps of 0.1 on [1, 2]; the curve crosses the x-axis at about x = 1.32.
answer_figure.caption: Graph of \(y = x^{3} - x - 1\) on \([1, 2]\); it crosses the x-axis at \(x \approx 1.32\) (original drawing)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (Answers 8.1) mein Question 2 ke jawab Question 1 ke foran baad "2." likhe baghair chhap gaye hain: "1. (i) 0.36 (ii) 1.86 (i) 1.32 (ii) 0.85 (iii) 7.39". Doosra group, yani (i) 1.32, (ii) 0.85, (iii) 7.39, asal mein Question 2 ke jawab hain. Jawab khud durust hain; sirf number "2." reh gaya hai, is liye confuse na hon.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to two decimal places using the graphical method, by finding some interval of sign change: \(f(x) = xe^{x} - 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi interval diya nahin gaya, is liye pehle poore numbers se interval dhoondna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = xe^{x} - 2\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan \(xe^{x} = 2\) ho, yani graph \(x\)-axis ko kaate, do decimals tak.
Rule kaunsa? LRT aur graphical method. Algebra se hal nahin, kyun ke \(x\) exponential ke bahar bhi hai aur andar bhi.
Plan: continuity, interval, 0.1 ke qadmon par table, graph, zoom, aur LRT se tasdeeq.
Yaad rakhiye: \(xe^{x}\) ka matlab hai \(x\) ko \(e^{x}\) se zarb (multiply) karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = xe^{x} - 2\).
Maloom karna: is ka real root, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: graphical method. \(x\) exponential ke bahar bhi hai aur power mein bhi, is liye \(xe^{x} = 2\) ko algebra se \(x\) ke liye hal nahin kar sakte (log lene se bhi \(x\) alag nahin hota).

Continuity
\[f(c) = \lim_{x \to c}(xe^{x} - 2) \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}\]
Kyun: \(x\) aur \(e^{x}\) dono continuous hain, un ka product bhi continuous hai, aur us mein se 2 minus karne se bhi continuity par koi farq nahin parta.

Interval of sign change dhoondein
\[f(0) = 0 - 2 = -2 < 0\]
\[f(1) = e - 2 = 0.7183 > 0\]
Kyun: sign 0 aur 1 ke beech badla, is liye \([0, 1]\) interval of sign change hai. Negative \(x\) ka kya? Wahan \(x\) negative aur \(e^{x}\) positive hai, to \(xe^{x}\) negative hai, aur \(f(x) < -2\) rehta hai. Yani negative taraf koi root nahin; yahi ek root hai.

Graph banana
Kyun: points plot kar ke smooth curve banaiye (answer figure dekhiye). Curve \((0, -2)\) se \((1, 0.72)\) tak upar jati hai, aur axis ko 0.8 aur 0.9 ke beech, taqreeban darmiyan mein kaatti hai.
Dhyan dein: 0.8 aur 0.9 ke beech curve kaafi tezi se upar jati hai, is liye crossing ke qareeb points ko ghaur se plot kijiye; zara si ghalti doosre decimal ko badal sakti hai.

0.01 ke qadmon par zoom
\[f(0.83) = -0.0965\]
\[f(0.84) = -0.0543\]
\[f(0.85) = -0.0113\]
\[f(0.86) = 0.0323\]
\[f(0.87) = 0.0766\]
Kyun: sign 0.85 aur 0.86 ke beech badla, aur \(f(0.85) = -0.0113\) zero ke \(f(0.86) = 0.0323\) se kahin zyada qareeb hai. Is liye crossing 0.85 ke paas hai: \(x \approx 0.85\).
Yaad rakhiye: jo value zero ke zyada qareeb ho, root aksar usi point ke paas hota hai, magar pakka faisla hamesha agla sign test karta hai.

Tasdeeq: do decimal places pakke karein
\[f(0.845) = -0.0329 < 0\]
\[f(0.855) = 0.0104 > 0\]
Kyun: LRT ke mutabiq root \(]0.845, 0.855[\) mein hai, jo round ho kar 0.85 banta hai. Answer key mein bhi 0.85 hai.
Dhyan dein: \(xe^{x}\) ko \(e^{x}\) ki power \(x\) ke saath na milaiye; yeh \(x\) guna \(e^{x}\) hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = x e^x - 2 plotted through the points at steps of 0.1 on [0, 1]; the curve crosses the x-axis at about x = 0.85.
answer_figure.caption: Graph of \(y = xe^{x} - 2\) on \([0, 1]\); it crosses the x-axis at \(x \approx 0.85\) (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to two decimal places using the graphical method, by finding some interval of sign change: \(f(x) = \ln(x) - 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Interval diya nahin gaya. \(\ln x\) bohat aahista barhta hai, is liye sign change dekhne ke liye humein kaafi bare whole numbers tak jana parega.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \ln(x) - 2\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan \(\ln x = 2\) ho, graph se, do decimals tak.
Rule kaunsa? LRT aur graphical method; aakhir mein exact hal \(e^{2}\) se tasdeeq.
Plan: domain aur continuity, interval, table, graph, zoom (5 decimals ke saath), aur LRT se tasdeeq.
Dhyan dein: \(\ln\) ka matlab natural log hai (base \(e\)); calculator ka "log" button base 10 hai, us se ghalat jawab aayega.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \ln(x) - 2\).
Maloom karna: is ka real root, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: graphical method, jaisa sawal kehta hai. (Yeh equation exact bhi hal ho sakti hai; woh hum aakhir mein tasdeeq ke liye istemal karenge.)

Domain aur continuity
\[f(c) = \lim_{x \to c}(\ln x - 2) \quad \forall c > 0\]
Kyun: \(\ln x\) sirf \(x > 0\) ke liye defined aur continuous hai. Is liye zero ya negative numbers try karne ka faida nahin; calculator wahan error dega.

Interval of sign change dhoondein
\[f(1) = 0 - 2 = -2\]
\[f(7) = 1.9459 - 2 = -0.0541\]
\[f(8) = 2.0794 - 2 = 0.0794\]
Kyun: \(f(1), f(2), \ldots, f(7)\) sab negative hain; sign pehli dafa 7 aur 8 ke beech badla, is liye \([7, 8]\) interval of sign change hai. \(\ln x\) hamesha barhta hai (increasing), is liye sirf ek hi root hai.

Graph banana
Kyun: \([7, 8]\) par values bohat chhoti hain, is liye \(y\)-axis ka scale bara rakhiye (0.02 ke qadam). Curve \((7, -0.054)\) se \((8, 0.079)\) tak taqreeban seedhi line hai aur axis ko 7.3 aur 7.4 ke beech kaatti hai (answer figure dekhiye).
Dhyan dein: agar \(y\)-scale 1, 2, 3 rakha to poori curve axis ke saath chipki nazar aayegi aur kuch parha nahin jayega.

0.01 ke qadmon par zoom (5 decimal places)
\[f(7.37) = -0.00258\]
\[f(7.38) = -0.00123\]
\[f(7.39) = 0.00013\]
\[f(7.40) = 0.00148\]
\[f(7.41) = 0.00283\]
Kyun: yahan \(f\) bohat aahista badalta hai, is liye 4 decimals se sign saaf nazar nahin aate; 5 decimals rakhe. Sign 7.38 aur 7.39 ke beech badla, aur \(f(7.39) = 0.00013\) taqreeban zero hai, is liye \(x \approx 7.39\).

Tasdeeq: do decimal places pakke karein
\[f(7.385) = -0.00055 < 0\]
\[f(7.395) = 0.00080 > 0\]
Kyun: LRT ke mutabiq root \(]7.385, 7.395[\) mein hai, jo round ho kar 7.39 banta hai. Exact hal se bhi dekh lein: \(\ln x = 2 \Rightarrow x = e^{2} = 7.3891\), jo 7.39 hi banta hai, aur answer key mein bhi 7.39 hai.
Yeh sawal is liye bhi achha hai ke yahan hum exact jawab jaante hain, to graphical method ki accuracy khud aazma sakte hain. Graph ne 7.39 diya aur exact jawab bhi 7.39 hai; method ne bilkul theek kaam kiya.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = ln x - 2 plotted through the points at steps of 0.1 on [7, 8]; the curve crosses the x-axis at about x = 7.39.
answer_figure.caption: Graph of \(y = \ln x - 2\) on \([7, 8]\); it crosses the x-axis at \(x \approx 7.39\) (original drawing)
